categories.main_business_segments: Xiamen Voke Mold & Plastic Engineering Co., Ltd. primarily operates in precision injection molds, injection molded parts, and downstream health products. The company has developed a 'mold-plastic integration' production model, offering a product line that includes precision injection molds, injection molded parts, and health products such as air purifiers. Its products serve multiple industries including automotive, health home appliances, outdoor home furnishings, and electronics/robotics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in precision injection mold design, manufacturing, and assembly, employing advanced manufacturing technologies such as five-axis CNC machining, CNC EDM, CNC wire cutting, and injection molding. It integrates mold design, processing, assembly, and testing with digital management systems like MES and ERP to enhance production efficiency and quality. The company also develops innovative technologies including high-gloss spray-free plastic molding, multi-color injection molding, and smart manufacturing techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading enterprises in automotive (e.g., Joyson Electronics, Gentherm, Brose Group), health home appliances (e.g., Vesync, REEFAN, Sandbirds), outdoor home furnishings (e.g., IKEA, Bugaboo, VELUX), and electronics/robotics sectors (e.g., Commscope, NIDEC, Honeywell). The company serves global markets with diversified end markets spanning automotive components, health appliances, consumer electronics, and outdoor products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production bases in multiple domestic locations including Xiamen, Shanghai, Tianjin, and Quanzhou, as well as overseas in Germany (Jena), Malaysia (Johor Bahru), Mexico (Saltillo), Vietnam (Long An), Singapore, and the United States. This global footprint supports its international customer base and enhances its competitiveness in various regional markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xiamen Voke operates across the upstream, midstream, and downstream segments of the plastic molding supply chain. It manufactures precision injection molds (upstream), produces injection molded parts (midstream), and assembles health products such as air purifiers (downstream), creating a vertically integrated manufacturing system with synergistic effects.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation with a focus on large, precise, and complex molds, intelligent manufacturing, and micro-foaming injection molding. It invests in R&D for silicone molds, multi-color injection products, and high-gloss surface technologies. The firm also prioritizes digital transformation through ERP, MES, and PLM systems, and plans to expand production capacity and optimize product portfolios to strengthen global market presence.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized precision molds and injection molded parts, as well as OEM and ODM production of health products for brand customers. The company also employs consignment sales for some injection molded parts, where products are stored at customer or third-party warehouses and revenue is recognized upon customer withdrawal.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is recognized as a leading precision injection mold manufacturer in China and one of the few domestic firms with a global production base. It competes with international and domestic mold and plastic product manufacturers, leveraging its integrated mold-plastic-health product model, advanced technology, and global footprint to maintain a competitive position in automotive, health appliances, and electronics sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.82 billion, a 35.64% increase over the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 220 million, up 31.05%. It maintains steady growth with expanding production volumes and sales, supported by increased R&D investment (R&D expenses of RMB 86 million, 4.74% of revenue). The company has total assets of about RMB 3.92 billion and equity of RMB 3.12 billion as of year-end 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xiamen Voke emphasizes its integrated mold-plastic-health product manufacturing capability, enabling one-stop solutions that reduce customer costs and improve supply chain efficiency. Its core competitive advantages include advanced precision mold technology, diversified product applications, global production and service network, stringent quality control with certifications like ISO9001 and IATF16949, rapid customer response, and strong R&D capabilities with over 500 patents.
